question: Rotterdam has no room - what is in it?
text: Pick Rotterdam DC: 31,969,768.60 of stock, 4 of the 14 reorder lines, and a single bar at 94% - the fullest of the five. Only 6,800.67 of its stock is slow-moving, one networking SKU, so clearing dead stock will not make the room: the two accessories lines at the top of its list, 1,080 and 718 units to order, are what needs somewhere to go.

question: And everything we hold, not just what is short?
text: Untick Below reorder level only: the table goes from 14 rows to all 1,000, the whole stock book. Nothing else on the page moves - the stock value was always all of it, and 14 SKUs are below their level whether or not the list is showing only them.

question: Just the buying area I look after?
text: Pick Office Furniture and Smart Home: 12,391,869.03 of stock and 4 lines to order, three of them Smart Home. Slow-mover value comes back empty, and that is the answer - not one SKU in either category has gone 90 days without a sale, so there is nothing here to clear. Space used does not narrow: a building's fill is all of its stock.
